tools_used: jsonschema validation of the written outputs
helpful: The blinded staging area with the captured retrieval_log.json per candidate: call classes, timestamps and result_capture markers made the forward-mode leakage check mechanical.
The frozen context block on each prediction (band + salience_version + term) made the base-rate basis unambiguous.
The statpack table caption stating how many Terms are rendered, which settled the window question without a flag.
gaps: A small helper that prints the pooled risk-set rate for a (band, salience_version, term) triple from the committed statpack would remove hand arithmetic from every cert evaluation.
The result_capture=unobserved engine's log carries only query strings, so what that candidate actually saw in its web search cannot be checked; a provider-side result digest would help.
notes: No corpus or CourtListener lookup was needed: a forward cert cell resolved nineteen days after the prediction leaves nothing to check beyond the staged log dates and the committed statpack.
